preamble: The alveolar trill or tap [r] is spirantized and devoiced to the voiceless retroflex fricative [ʂ]. In Copala Triqui (Mixtecan) this happened to Proto-Trique *r once the following vowel was lost and *r came to stand before a consonant; the resulting /ʂ/ is a derived phoneme that cannot be reconstructed for Proto-Trique, while Chicahuaxtla Triqui keeps r in the same words.

examples.note: The vowel was lost between *r and a following *t, *k, *kw, *m, *n or *l (rmii), and *r then became ʂ; Chicahuaxtla has rumi.

sources: Matsukawa, K. (2008). Reconstruction of Proto-Trique Phonemes. University of Pennsylvania Working Papers in Linguistics 14(1), 269–281. https://repository.upenn.edu/handle/20.500.14332/44671
